retrievalProfile.description: A clean studio portrait featuring a male artist in early 2000s fashion against a solid cyan backdrop with subtle geometric digital overlays.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
vintage film grain is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-full shot of a male subject centered against a vibrant cyan-blue background. The subject wears a white linen shirt, denim, and a light-colored fedora, looking downward. A cluster of semi-transparent blue squares floats behind the subject's left side, creating a digital-pixel effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head tilted down
High contrast between white shirt and cyan background
Text overlaying the subject's chest and the background
Geometric square pattern providing depth to the flat background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white shirt acts as the primary visual anchor due to its brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the fedora, follows the downward gaze to the hands, then moves right to the typography and geometric squares.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat cyan on the left and right sides create a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Brown and Dark Blue (Denim and Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high-value (bright) subject clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, white, denim blue, and earth tones.

composition.overlap: Overlaps white shirt and cyan background

treatment.fill: Two-tone (Brown for first word, White for second)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color contrast to distinguish words.
graphicDevices: Floating semi-transparent squares in various shades of blue

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, early-2000s commercial feel.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a white linen shirt and fedora against a solid cyan background, leaving space on the right for text. Include a cluster of semi-transparent blue squares behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold uppercase sans-serif text across the center-right. Color the first word dark brown and the second word white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant cyan?
Does the text overlap both the shirt and the background?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the fedora style is generic
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the subject cutout
Ensure the two-tone text is legible
Verify the geometric squares do not obscure the face
Confirm the downward-facing pose is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Solid Cyan Backdrop + White Linen Clothing + Geometric Pixel Overlay + Bold Two-Tone Sans-Serif Typography
